items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: if you listen to Rudy Valli, and especially to Dick Stabile on records

ctx.x: Who was the most smelty organ player in the world. And there was no way by listening to Fats Waller's music that you were going to say that he was influenced by that organ.

Well, what I am saying is that if you listen to Rudy Valli, and especially to Dick Stabile on records, and if you listen to them... You're going to hear all those fast changes that Parker makes? You're going to hear all those things that Parker makes. I don't believe it. Well, try it and see. I don't believe that. I recommend that you try it and see, because it'll be illuminating for you to do that. And I considered that Charlie Parker was very pleasant. He had a tendency to be narcissistic. He was friendly but…
I hear a lot of protest in Charlie Parker.
